Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map Nos. 4-1 and 4-J at 1554 and
                              1559 S Kedzie Ave.
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe B3-2,
Community Shopping District symbols and Indications as shown on Map No. 4-1 and 4-J
in the area bound by:

      a line 53.75 feet north ofand parallel to West 16'" Street; South Sawyer Avenue; a line
      28.75 feet north of and parallel to West 16'" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to
      South Sawyer Avenue; West 16'" Street; and the alley next west of and parallel to South
      Sawyer Avenue,

to those ofa B2-1, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           lyuqhael Scott Jr.
                                                           Arderman, 24*" Ward
